Text:
EMPIRICAL INTRAVENOUS REGIMENS WITHOUT VANCOMYCIN
Gentamicin is optional.  Contact Hematology-Oncology or Infectious Diseases for advice.

[References](references)

Hughes WT  Clin Infect Dis 2002, 34: 730
Rolston KVI Clin Infect Dis 2004, 39: S44
Sipsas NV  Cancer 2005, 103: 1103
Therapy:
## Inpatient

Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h ($35/day) [R]
< OR >
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q8h ($$) [R] extended infusion
< OR >
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q8h ($$) [R] extended infusion <AND> Gentamicin 5 mg/kg IV q24h ($) [R,O]

### Alternatives for penicillin allergy

Vancomycin must be added to aztreonam for coverage of Gram-positive organisms.

Aztreonam 2 gm IV q8h ($50/day) <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h

($6/day) [R] < OR >
Aztreonam 2 gm IV q8h ($50/day) <AND> gentamicin 5 mg/kg IV q24h ($3/day)

[R] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h ($6.00/day) [R]

## ER/UC

Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h ($35/day) R  < OR >

Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h ($33/day) R < OR >

Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h ($33/day) R <AND> gentamicin 5
mg/kg IV q24h ($3/day) [R]

### Alternatives for penicillin allergy

Vancomycin must be added to aztreonam for coverage of Gram-positive organisms.

Aztreonam 2 gm IV q8h ($50/day) <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h

($6/day) [R] < OR >
Aztreonam 2 gm IV q8h ($50/day) <AND> gentamicin 5 mg/kg IV q24h ($3/day)

[R] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h ($6.00/day) [R]
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU EMP INTRAV W/O VANCO
ERUC: ORZID GMENU ER/UC EMP INTRAV W/O VANCO
